submission.justification: Algorithm-L2 has the highest efficiency (92% at 35 GeV) but is flagged non-deployable in Level-1 hardware, so it is excluded. Algorithm-L3 is deployable but has lower efficiency than L1 at every threshold tested (e.g. 74% vs 85% at 35 GeV; best L3 point is 73.6% at 30 GeV). Among the deployable candidates, Algorithm-L1 gives the highest signal efficiency. Within the 20-60 GeV range, the L1 efficiency curve peaks around 35-40 GeV (84.1% at 30, 85.3% at 40, 81.0% at 50, 71.6% at 60). The 40 GeV point is the best recorded value, with a mean of about 85.7% over reruns. However, the run-to-run spread is about 2.5%, and the 35 GeV and 38 GeV points are statistically indistinguishable from 40 GeV. The main caveat is the rate. No measured L1 trigger rate was recorded for any threshold. The 8 kHz value is only the allocation, so the 8 kHz budget is not verified for 40 GeV. Also, the recorded 85.7% final value does not exactly match the mean of the three listed 40 GeV runs (about 85.9%). The recommendation should be confirmed with a rate measurement at 40 GeV before deployment. If the rate exceeds 8 kHz, a slightly higher threshold (about 42-45 GeV) would be needed, at a cost in efficiency.

requirements.requirement: Goal: highest possible signal efficiency among allowed options
requirements.evidence: Among deployable candidates, L1 at 40 GeV has the highest recorded efficiency (~85.7% mean over reruns; L3 peaks at 73.6%). L2 has higher efficiency (92%) but is not deployable.

requirements.requirement: Goal: stay within allocated L1 trigger rate of 8 kHz
requirements.evidence: No measured trigger rate was recorded for any threshold. final_rate_khz = 8 and allocated_rate_khz = 8 are the allocation, not a measurement. Rate at 40 GeV must be verified before deployment.

Run-to-run spread at 40 GeV is 2.47%, comparable to differences between 35, 38, 40 GeV points. The recorded final efficiency 85.7% does not exactly match the mean of the three listed 40 GeV runs (about 85.87%). The 40 GeV optimum is therefore not clearly separated from neighbouring thresholds.
